The '''Blue Cowboy Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the [[Skull Cavern]] (≈1.92% chance).<ref name="skullcavernchance" /> It can also rarely be found in [[the Mines]] as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]], from special monster drops or crates and barrels, during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|'Danger In The Deep']] quest or after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]].<ref name="dangermineschance" />
